purpose: Single secret-free source of truth for project-scoped MCP capability. Host configuration files are generated from this manifest by scripts/render_agent_configs.py and verified by scripts/validate_workspace.py. Never add credentials, API keys, tokens, or header values here.
boundary: Documentation and public web research only. Customer AWS account access is exclusively the broker-mediated aws-customer-account-ops skill, which is user-level, credential-bearing, externally owned, and therefore never committed to this repository.
enforcement_layers: Layer 1 - server side, host independent: mcp-proxy-for-aws runs with --read-only, which drops every tool not annotated readOnlyHint=true, and with --skip-auth so no AWS credential is presented.
Layer 2 - host side: each generated host configuration denies the blocked tool list. Codex additionally expresses an exact allow list.

Layer 1 alone is not sufficient because --read-only still leaves read-capable tools that this repository does not route. Layer 2 alone is not sufficient because Kiro and Claude Code express deny lists rather than allow lists, so a newly added upstream tool would otherwise appear.

blocked_tool_reasons.aws___call_aws: Direct AWS API execution. Customer-account access must go through the broker.
blocked_tool_reasons.aws___run_script: Sandboxed script execution. Not a routed capability.
blocked_tool_reasons.aws___get_tasks: Read-only but not a routed capability; keeps the tool catalog small.
blocked_tool_reasons.aws___retrieve_skill: Fetches external skill text that would bypass repository routing.

evidence.method: stdio initialize + tools/list against the pinned proxy with no AWS credential
streamable HTTP initialize + tools/list in anonymous mode

servers.data_handling: Never send customer names, contacts, Account or Payer IDs, IPs, CIDRs, confidential ticket text, or credentials to this endpoint.

hosts.notes: Kiro supports disabledTools only. Layer 1 --read-only is what stops an unlisted write tool from appearing.
Server definitions live in .mcp.json; tool denial lives in .claude/settings.json permissions.deny using mcp__<server>__<tool>.
Codex supports enabled_tools, so the exact allow list is expressed directly. Project-scoped config applies to trusted projects only.
Hermes stores MCP configuration in its own profile, not in the repository. Configure it to match this manifest and record the result in agents/runtime-status.md.
